title: 第一卷 第7章 全场哗然，百年天才
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
三日苦修，日夜不辍。

    苏玄尘的修为，稳步精进。

    原本初入炼气一层的粗浅根基，被彻底打磨圆满。

    体内淤积百年的经脉杂质，被精纯灵气冲刷十之三四。

    肉身衰败、气血枯竭的状态，得到极大改善。

    他能清晰感觉到，自己的身体一日强过一日。

    距离炼气二层，只差一步之遥。

    只要愿意，借助古卷提纯丹药，他随时可以瞬间破境。

    但他依旧压下突破欲望。

    根基，越扎实，未来大道越稳。

    暮年修仙，根基就是命！

    这日清晨，清脆的传召之声响彻整片外门。

    “所有外门弟子，即刻前往前山广场集合！不得延误！”

    声声回荡，层层传远。

    宗门紧急召集，必有大事。

    苏玄尘收起古卷，整理好灰布弟子衣衫，推门而出。

    一路前行，山道之上，无数外门弟子络绎汇聚。

    少年、青年居多，个个朝气蓬勃、意气风发。

    唯独他一人白发佝偻，行走其中，格格不入。

    沿途无数目光扫来，好奇、轻视、戏谑、不解。

    百岁修仙的消息，短短三日，早已传遍整个外门。

    所有人都知道，青玄宗收了一位史无前例的高龄弟子。

    多数人只当是宗门一时糊涂，收了个无用老朽。

    少数人听过些许风声，知晓这老者似乎真的引气入体成功，更是心生诧异。
content_en:
Three days of hard training, day and night.

    Su Xuanchen's cultivation has steadily improved.

    The rough foundation that originally entered the first level of Qi Refining was completely polished and perfected.

    Three out of ten impurities accumulated in the meridians in the body for hundreds of years were washed away by the pure spiritual energy.

    The state of physical decay and Qi and blood depletion has been greatly improved.

    He could clearly feel that his body was getting stronger day by day.

    It is only one step away from the second level of Qi Refining.

    As long as he is willing, he can break through the realm instantly at any time with the help of ancient scrolls to purify the elixir.

    But he still suppressed his desire to break through.

    The more solid the foundation, the more stable the future will be.

    The foundation of cultivating immortality in your later years is your destiny!

    In the early morning of this morning, the clear voice of summons resounded throughout the outer gate.

    "All outer disciples, gather at Qianshan Square immediately! No delay!"

    The sound echoed and spread far and wide.

    The sect summoned urgently, something big must happen.

    Su Xuanchen put away the ancient scrolls, arranged the gray cloth disciple's clothes, and pushed out the door.

    Along the way, countless outer disciples gathered on the mountain road.

    There are mostly teenagers and young people, all of whom are full of energy and high spirits.

    He was the only one with white hair and rickets, and he looked out of place when walking among them.

    Along the way, countless eyes glanced at me, showing curiosity, contempt, teasing, and confusion.

    The news of the hundred-year-old cultivating immortality had already spread throughout the outer sect in just three days.

    Everyone knows that Qingxuan Sect has accepted an unprecedented senior disciple.

    Most people just thought that the sect was temporarily confused and accepted a useless old man.

    A few people had heard some rumors and were even more surprised to know that the old man seemed to have succeeded in drawing Qi into his body.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 7 The whole audience was in an uproar, a century-old genius
